title: I had a dream

location.series: KMS TEAM / Audi and Audi Sport identity case study

slide_intent: Give a short statement a distinct visual voice because the tone of a message comes from its typography and image as well as its words.
strategic_value: The red headline over a candid monochrome portrait can make Audi’s communication feel direct and human.
demonstration: A large red I had a dream headline crosses a black-and-white photograph of a man leaning beside an open car, with the face cropped at the top.
practical_value: Compare the intimacy of the image with the assertive scale and color of the statement.

content_islands.name: Human photograph
content_islands.spec: Fill the composition with the cropped figure and car, preserving the high-key background.

content_islands.name: Statement
content_islands.spec: Place the large red headline horizontally across the upper-middle image.

reference_purposes.Expression: Red heavy lettering contrasts with the monochrome, closely cropped human photograph.
reference_purposes.Application: The artwork demonstrates the identity’s typographic and photographic treatment in a campaign composition.
